name: prisma-oed
summary: PRISMA (Physics-informed Regression and Inference for Statistics-driven Measurement Acquisition) is a Bayesian online nonlinear regression algorithm for active learning and SOED in spectroscopy experiments.
author: Xavier Tricoche, Andy Mounce, Sam Lilak, Devika Mehta, Leo Diaz, Luca Basso, Ezra Bussmann
